publication: Sharjah 24 annual department disclosures, corroborated by Emirates News Agency
sourceMethod: Selected numerical facts transcribed from dated reports of department disclosures; article text and images are excluded.
limits: Annual emirate-wide reported totals, not transaction records, commercial-only sales, sale prices, current listings, a project register, or a complete Sharjah project denominator. Trading value includes transaction types beyond sales. The 2024 report did not print an exact overall registration or sale count in these sources; those fields remain null. The 2025 report did not print a new-project count. Values are rounded at their stated precision. Annual periods must not be added to any same-year partial cumulative period.
